title: docs(qa): hyphenate the scratch package ids twelve checklist items name

_Requested by **Yibo Wang** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01BVUyyPie8gHwoPM18iABwB?thread=cmsg_01BVUyyPie8gHwoPM18iABwBG1idkCU89FcQr91kCNuWyT)_

Fixes #32330

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：平台测试清单里 12 个条目给临时测试包写的包 id 带下划线（`com.qa.addr_a`、`com.qa.addr_b`、`com.qa.n_one`、`com.qa.n_two`），全部改成连字符写法（`com.qa.addr-a` 等），覆盖夹具、步骤、预期文字和反例；命名空间（`qa_a`、`qa_b`、`qa_n`）和带命名空间的地址不变。每个条目升 `revision` 并追加一行 history，FOLLOW-UPS §19b 追加一行"已由 #32330 修复"。
- 为什么改：`objectstack build` 拒收带下划线的包 id，测试人员照着清单原样做，连这对测试包都装不上；M4 验证运行（#32316）已用连字符写法跑通。
- 风险与回滚：只改 `docs/qa/platform-checklist/` 的清单数据和跟进记录，不动产品代码，没有条款含义变化；回滚即 revert 本 PR。
- 先看：`docs/qa/platform-checklist/areas/api-backend.json`（`meta-qualified-item-read` 在步骤与预期报错里也引用了这些 id，改动最多）、`areas/platform-core.json`（`n` 这一对的命名空间实为 `qa_n`）、`FOLLOW-UPS.md` §19b 新增行。
- 两分钟验证：`node scripts/check-platform-checklist.mjs && git grep -n 'com\.qa\.\(addr\|n\)_' -- docs/qa/platform-checklist/areas`，预期校验 OK、grep 无输出。
- 需要你做的：无，席位落地。

## What changes

Twelve items named the scratch package ids with an underscore. Every occurrence in each item body now uses the hyphen spelling. Each item bumps `revision` and appends a `history` row: a fixture-text correction with no clause change, citing #32316 and this card. History rows are append-only and were not touched.

| Item | Where the id appeared | Revision |
|:--|:--|:--|
| `access-security.permission-set-package-resolution` | fixtures, acceptance | 1 → 2 |
| `access-security.sharing-queue-assignment-package-resolution` | fixtures, acceptance | 1 → 2 |
| `access-security.permission-set-address-in-execution-context` | fixtures, steps, acceptance, negative | 1 → 2 |
| `ai.mcp-namespace-faces` | fixtures | 1 → 2 |
| `api-backend.actions-namespace-address` | fixtures | 1 → 2 |
| `api-backend.meta-qualified-item-read` | fixtures, steps, acceptance, negative | 1 → 2 |
| `api-backend.automation-namespace-address` | fixtures (`addr_b` only) | 2 → 3 |
| `api-backend.client-sdk-namespace-address` | fixture aside on the rule (not on the card's list) | 2 → 3 |
| `automation.flow-reference-package-resolution` | fixtures, acceptance | 1 → 2 |
| `integration-system.job-package-key` | fixtures, acceptance | 1 → 2 |
| `platform-core.namespace-co-owner-name-refusal` | fixtures, steps, acceptance (`n_one`, `n_two`) | 1 → 2 |
| `platform-core.bare-name-one-holder-refusal` | fixtures, acceptance | 1 → 2 |

`FOLLOW-UPS.md` §19b gains one sub-bullet under the underscore finding, recording the fix and the twelfth item.

**The package-id rule, read at `7575116c`.** `packages/spec/src/kernel/manifest.zod.ts#MANIFEST_ID_PATTERN` admits lowercase dot-separated segments of letters, digits and inner hyphens, with no underscore. `manifest.id` is checked against it with the error `manifestIdRefusal('manifest.id', …)`. `objectstack build` runs `Compile` (`packages/cli/src/commands/build.ts`), which runs `ObjectStackDefinitionSchema.safeParse` (`packages/cli/src/commands/compile.ts`), so a build of an underscore id prints:

```text
Invalid package id 'com.qa.addr_a'. A package id (`manifest.id`) is written in reverse-domain notation, like 'com.acme.crm' or 'org.example.help-desk' — lowercase dot-separated segments of letters, digits and inner hyphens; a segment may not open with a hyphen; underscores are not admitted. Did you mean 'com.qa.addr-a'?
```

(The text came from calling `manifestIdRefusal` from source at the base. The M4 run, #32316, saw the same refusal from a real build.) The namespace grammar, `packages/spec/src/kernel/address-grammar.ts#NAMESPACE_PATTERN` (letter first, then 1 to 19 of lowercase letters, digits or underscore), admits `qa_a`, `qa_b` and `qa_n`, so no namespace changes.

## Acceptance notes

- **Twelve items, not eleven.** `api-backend.client-sdk-namespace-address` was promoted by #32316, and its ids were already hyphenated there. Its fixture aside quoted the refused spelling as an example ("the manifest id grammar refuses com.qa.addr_a at build"). That left a literal hit for the order's grep gate, so the aside now says the grammar "refuses an underscore in a package id at build". This is a wording change with the same meaning, revision 2 → 3.
- **The `n` pair's namespace is `qa_n`.** The card and the order list `n_one`/`n_two` beside the namespaces, but in `platform-core.namespace-co-owner-name-refusal` both packages declare the namespace `qa_n` (that collision is the point of the item). `qa_n` is unchanged, and `n_one`/`n_two` appear only inside the package ids.
- **Expected text.** Every id quoted in an expected answer is one the product echoes from the installed manifest: 409 `candidates`, refusal messages naming the holders, `permission_set_package`, `package_id` and the `jobKeyFor` key `com.qa.addr-b:qa_nightly`. So they all follow the fixture spelling. No product text spells the id on its own.

## Verification

- `git grep -n 'com\.qa\.\(addr\|n\)_' -- docs/qa/platform-checklist/areas`: no output (exit 1). Before the edit, 30 lines matched across six area files.
- `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands` derived 16 families. All 16 ran with exit 0, and `--ran` gives `16 derived famil(ies) accounted for — 16 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED`. `check:doc-formula-expressions` first exited 3 (prerequisite: `@objectstack/formula` and `@objectstack/lint` unbuilt). After `turbo run build` of those two, it exited 0.
